title: Gancao Xiexin decoction alleviates 5-fluorouracil-induced intestinal mucositis by inhibiting ACSL4 and activating Keap1-Nrf2 pathway.
authors: Yang, Shan; Chen, Xiaotong; Gong, Yuxia; Liu, Ting; Xiao, Ying; Shen, Xiaofei; Meng, Xianli; Chen, Yu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方缓解化疗性肠黏膜炎的铁死亡机制，虽含分子对接与动力学模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: 5-Fluorouracil (5-Fu) is a commonly used chemotherapy drug, but it frequently induces toxic side effects such as intestinal mucositis and is closely associated with ferroptosis‌. Gancao Xiexin (GCXX) decoction, a renowned formula in traditional Chinese medicine, is widely employed for treating gastrointestinal inflammatory diseases. However, the therapeutic effects and underlying mechanisms of GCXX on 5-Fu-induced intestinal mucositis remain unclear‌. This study aims to investigate whether GCXX alleviates 5-Fu-induced intestinal mucositis in mice by suppressing ferroptosis. Using a 5-Fu-induced intestinal mucositis mouse model, we found that oral administration of GCXX not only effectively alleviated 5-Fu-induced intestinal mucositis symptoms including weight loss, diarrhea, and colon shortening, but also reduced pathological changes such as villi atrophy, crypt damage, and goblet cell depletion. Furthermore, GCXX significantly mitigated 5-Fu-triggered intestinal barrier dysfunction by restoring proliferating cell nuclear antigen (PCNA) and occludin expression while reducing myeloperoxidase (MPO) expression of colon tissues and serum levels of diamine oxidase (DAO), interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta), and tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha). Mechanistically, GCXX reduced ferroptosis biomarkers including accumulation of iron and 4-hydroxynonenal (4-HNE) via reducing Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap1) expression and activating nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) anti-oxidant pathway, as well as down-regulating long-chain-fatty-acid-CoA ligase 4 (ACSL4) expression and mitogen-activated protein kinases (MAPKs) activation. Molecular docking, dynamics simulation, and drug affinity responsive target stability (DARTS) assays confirmed a stable binding of liquiritin (the main active component of GCXX) with ACSL4 and Keap1, elucidating its anti-ferroptosis mechanism. Our findings demonstrated that GCXX alleviated 5-Fu-induced intestinal mucositis in mice through blocking ferroptosis by activating the Keap1-Nrf2 signaling and inhibiting the ACSL4 and MAPKs pathway, further supporting its clinical utility in mitigating chemotherapy-related toxic side effects.
abstract_zh: 5-氟尿嘧啶（5-Fu）是一种常用的化疗药物，但常诱发肠黏膜炎等毒性副作用，且与铁死亡（ferroptosis）密切相关。甘草泻心汤（GCXX）作为中医经典方剂，广泛用于治疗胃肠道炎症性疾病。然而，GCXX对5-Fu诱导的肠黏膜炎的治疗效果及其潜在机制尚不清楚。本研究旨在探讨GCXX是否通过抑制铁死亡减轻小鼠5-Fu诱导的肠黏膜炎。利用5-Fu诱导的肠黏膜炎小鼠模型，我们发现口服GCXX不仅能有效缓解5-Fu诱导的肠黏膜炎症状，包括体重减轻、腹泻和结肠缩短，还能减少病理变化，如绒毛萎缩、隐窝损伤和杯状细胞耗竭。此外，GCXX通过恢复增殖细胞核抗原（PCNA）和occludin表达，同时降低结肠组织中髓过氧化物酶（MPO）表达及血清中二胺氧化酶（DAO）、白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）和肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）水平，显著减轻了5-Fu触发的肠道屏障功能障碍。机制上，GCXX通过降低Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap1）表达并激活核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）抗氧化通路，以及下调长链脂肪酸辅酶A连接酶4（ACSL4）表达和丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（MAPKs）激活，减少了铁死亡生物标志物，包括铁和4-羟基壬烯醛（4-HNE）的积累。分子对接、动力学模拟和药物亲和力响应靶标稳定性（DARTS）实验证实了甘草苷（GCXX的主要活性成分）与ACSL4和Keap1的稳定结合，阐明了其抗铁死亡机制。我们的研究结果表明，GCXX通过激活Keap1-Nrf2信号通路并抑制ACSL4和MAPKs通路阻断铁死亡，从而减轻小鼠5-Fu诱导的肠黏膜炎，进一步支持其在缓解化疗相关毒性副作用方面的临床应用价值。
